descFull: Benzi is a compiler-backed coding agent that compiles your codebase into a resolved, queryable map of calls, data flow, and control flow first; then it explains, runs, edits and verifies your code using it. Includes a runtime tracer that settles what static analysis can't. The Benzi compiler also works as an MCP server.
